about_the_game:
Enter the post-apocalyptic world as a pilot in this intense top-down action roguelike. Command your customizable combat mech through bullet-hell battles while managing crucial systems like power distribution and heat levels. Each run presents unique challenges and opportunities as you collect relics that can dramatically alter your vehicle's capabilities.

Key Features:

  • Deep Customization: Modify your vehicle with interchangeable parts including weapons, shields, coolers, power reactors, and hover pads

  • Dynamic Power Management: Balance your vehicle's energy distribution and heat levels across systems

  • Roguelike Elements: Discover and collect relics that provide unique buffs and debuffs, making each run different

  • Strategic Combat: Engage in tactical battles combining vehicular combat with bullet-hell elements

  • Advanced Power Control: Fine-tune power allocation to different systems for optimal performance
